items.title_en: Viral Baby Monkey Punch, Who Slept With A Stuffed Toy After Being Rejected By His Mom, Finally Finds A Family! See Video
items.title_zh: 被妈妈拒绝后抱着毛绒玩具睡觉的小猴子潘趣终于找到了家人！看视频
items.summary_en: After months of clinging to a stuffed toy for comfort, the internet's favourite baby macaque has finally been accepted by his troop in a heartwarming breakthrough
items.summary_zh: 经过几个月的坚持抱着毛绒玩具寻求安慰后，互联网上最受喜爱的小猕猴终于被他的队伍接受了，这是一个令人暖心的突破
